name: OpenDART (Open Data Analysis, Retrieval and Transfer System)
operator: Financial Supervisory Service (금융감독원, FSS) — Korea
docs_url: https://opendart.fss.or.kr/guide/main.do?apiGrpCd=DS001
region_main: South Korea (all DART filers: KOSPI, KOSDAQ, KONEX + non-listed public filers)
region_surroundings: None — Korea-domiciled filers only. Korean subsidiaries of foreign groups appear if they are DART filers.

plans.price: Free (CONFIRMED — no paid tier exists; registration required)
plans.what_you_get: CONFIRMED: full access to all 6 API groups — DS001 공시정보 (disclosure info), DS002 정기보고서 주요정보, DS003 정기보고서 재무정보, DS004 지분공시 종합정보, DS005 주요사항보고서 주요정보, DS006 증권신고서 주요정보. NOTE: the research brief mapped DS005 to 지분공시 — that is wrong. CONFIRMED from the site: DS004 = 지분공시 종합정보 (shareholding), DS005 = 주요사항보고서 주요정보 (material event reports, where the M&A decisions live).

api_access: CONFIRMED official REST API, no OAuth — a 40-character crtfc_key query parameter. Endpoints return .json or .xml (e.g. https://opendart.fss.or.kr/api/list.json). CONFIRMED key issuance via login + '인증키 신청/관리'; corporate applicants must supply company name, business registration number, contact, homepage and the REQUESTING SYSTEM IP + business registration certificate (Terms Art.7(1)). CONFIRMED Terms Art.19(5): '회원은 ID 및 인증키를 2개 이상 발급 받을 수 없습니다' — one member may hold only ONE key, so you cannot shard load across keys. CONFIRMED Terms Art.10(4): call volume is capped and the cap is posted on the site. CONFIRMED from the 공시검색 spec, error code 020 = '일반적으로는 20,000건 이상의 요청에 대하여 이 에러 메시지가 발생' — i.e. the widely-cited 20,000 calls/day cap is CONFIRMED as an error-message threshold, though the number is not stated as a headline 'daily limit' anywhere we could fetch. CONFIRMED page_count max = 100 records/page (default 10). CONFIRMED: without corp_code the search window is limited to 3 months per query ('고유번호가 없는 경우 검색기간은 3개월로 제한'). Language of data: Korean only (field names romanised, values Korean).
archive_window: INFERRED: DART itself holds filings from 1999 onward and the list API accepts arbitrary bgn_de/end_de, so ~1999-present is retrievable via API by paging in <=3-month windows (or per corp_code). The structured DS005 M&A-decision APIs are INFERRED to start around 2015-2016 (they parse a report format introduced later); earliest date is NOT stated in the docs we could fetch. Retention: permanent (statutory disclosure archive).
data_types: M&A-relevant, all CONFIRMED as named DS005 endpoints: 회사합병 결정 (merger decision, apiId 2020050), 회사분할 결정 (spin-off, 2020051), 회사분할합병 결정 (split-merger, 2020052), 주식교환·이전 결정 (share exchange/transfer, 2020053), 영업양수 결정 / 영업양도 결정 (business acquisition/transfer, 2020042/2020043), 타법인 주식 및 출자증권 양수결정 / 양도결정 (acquisition/disposal of shares in another company — the single most useful endpoint for subsidiary acquisitions, 2020046/2020047), 자산양수도(기타)·풋백옵션 (2020018). DS005 has 36 endpoints in total. DS004 (CONFIRMED): 대량보유 상황보고 (5% major-shareholding reports, 2019021) and 임원·주요주주 소유보고 (officer/major-shareholder ownership, 2019022) — the Korean equivalent of a 13D/大量保有報告書 feed, ideal for detecting stake building. DS001 (CONFIRMED): 공시검색 (disclosure search by type/company/date), 기업개황 (company profile master data), 공시서류원본파일 (original filing ZIP/XML), 고유번호 (bulk corp_code <-> company name <-> stock code mapping file — the master-data seed). Company master data: CONFIRMED via 기업개황 + 고유번호. Tender offers (공개매수신고서) sit in DS006 증권신고서 group / are findable via 공시검색 by report type (INFERRED for the exact endpoint).
formats: JSON and XML for structured APIs (CONFIRMED); original filings as ZIP containing XML/XBRL via 공시서류원본파일 (CONFIRMED); 고유번호 delivered as a ZIP'd XML file (CONFIRMED).
update_frequency: Real-time to near-real-time — filings appear as accepted by DART during the disclosure day (INFERRED; DART accepts filings continuously on business days).
limitations: Korean-language values only — you must maintain a Korean->Japanese/English mapping layer. Single API key per member (no sharding) and the corporate application ties the key to a registered source IP, so egress IPs must be static — this is the biggest architectural constraint. 3-month window cap on undirected date searches forces a paging strategy. The structured DS005/DS004 endpoints only cover reports filed in the machine-readable era; older deals need the raw-document API plus parsing. Terms do not explicitly grant or forbid redistribution (Art.16 only asserts FSS copyright) — get legal sign-off before republishing content to clients.
ma_relevance: Highest of any free source in Asia. It is the only jurisdiction in the region where merger decisions, share-acquisition decisions, business transfers and 5% stake reports are all available as clean structured JSON from an official regulator, for free.
implementation_notes: Effort: LOW-MEDIUM. Recommended build: (1) nightly refresh of 고유번호 into a company master table keyed on corp_code; (2) daily incremental poll of DS001 공시검색 for the previous day across all filers to get the filing index (rcept_no); (3) for each rcept_no whose report type matches an M&A pattern, call the matching DS005/DS004 structured endpoint to get typed fields; (4) fall back to 공시서류원본파일 + XML parsing only for report types with no structured endpoint. Budget well under 20,000 calls/day with this design. Register the key as a corporate account early — the IP registration step is the long lead time.
confidence: high

operator: Taiwan Stock Exchange Corporation (TWSE)

region_main: Taiwan — TWSE (上市) main-board listed companies

api_access: CONFIRMED official REST API. Base URL https://openapi.twse.com.tw/v1 (CONFIRMED from the spec). CONFIRMED no auth: a plain GET to /opendata/t187ap04_L returned 61 records of 上市公司每日重大訊息 (daily material information) with fields 出表日期, 發言日期, 發言時間, 公司代號, 公司名稱, 主旨, 符合條款, 事實發生日. CONFIRMED no rate limit is declared in the spec (INFERRED there is an undocumented soft limit — be polite). Language: Traditional Chinese; dates use the Republic-of-China calendar (CONFIRMED: '1150903' = 2026-09-03, i.e. ROC year 115) — you MUST convert ROC->Gregorian in ETL.
archive_window: CONFIRMED the material-information endpoint is a SAME-DAY SNAPSHOT ONLY — it returned only records with 出表日期 = the current date. There is no date parameter and no history via the API. History requires MOPS (see separate record). Retention via API: 1 day.
data_types: M&A-relevant (CONFIRMED): /opendata/t187ap04_L = 上市公司每日重大訊息 — the daily material-information feed, whose 主旨 field carries merger, acquisition, asset-transfer, share-transfer and change-of-control announcements, tagged by 符合條款 (the triggering clause number of the material-information rules) plus 事實發生日 (event date). Company master / corporate data (CONFIRMED): /company/newlisting (recent listings), /company/applylistingLocal and /company/applylistingForeign (IPO applicants — a useful pre-IPO target pipeline), /opendata/t187ap45_L (dividends), /opendata/t187ap05_P (monthly revenue for all public companies — a good size/growth screen), /opendata/t187ap46_L_6 (ESG board composition), /opendata/t187ap46_L_18 (top-10 shareholder holdings and control). CONFIRMED there is NO dedicated 股權分散 (shareholding dispersion) endpoint in the spec.
formats: JSON (CONFIRMED — the spec's endpoints return JSON arrays of flat objects). CSV is also offered by TWSE elsewhere on its site (INFERRED).
update_frequency: Daily, business days — the material-information dataset is regenerated each day with 出表日期 set to that day (CONFIRMED).
limitations: BIGGEST LIMITATION: no history — you must poll daily and accumulate, or you permanently lose the back-catalogue (backfill only via MOPS scraping). ROC calendar dates require conversion. Traditional Chinese only; 主旨 is free text, so deal-type classification needs NLP or a 符合條款 clause-code lookup table. 符合條款 codes are not documented in the spec (UNCONFIRMED meaning — build the code table from the material-information rules). Covers TWSE only; TPEx needs a second pipeline.
ma_relevance: High for Taiwan. This is the single best free, auth-free, structured M&A announcement feed in Taiwan, and one of the easiest ETL integrations in the whole region.
implementation_notes: Effort: LOW. Recommended: a cron job every business day (twice daily to be safe) that GETs /opendata/t187ap04_L, converts ROC dates, upserts on (公司代號 + 發言日期 + 發言時間 + 主旨 hash), and classifies 主旨 against an M&A keyword/clause-code list (併購, 合併, 收購, 取得或處分資產, 股權轉讓, 公開收購). START THIS FEED IMMEDIATELY even before the rest of the project — every day not collected is unrecoverable without scraping MOPS. Pair with the TPEx equivalent for full Taiwan coverage.
confidence: high
